func _run_tests() -> void:
	var main := await instantiate_main_scene()
	if not check("main", main != null, "La scena principale deve caricarsi senza errori"):
		return

	var flyer := find_by_name(main, "FlyingEnemy") as CharacterBody2D
	if not check("flyer_exists", flyer != null, "Nella scena main.tscn deve esserci il nodo FlyingEnemy"):
		return

	var start_y: float = flyer.global_position.y
	await wait_physics_frames(20)
	check("gravity_zero", absf(flyer.global_position.y - start_y) < 1.0, "Il nemico volante non deve cadere verso il basso per effetto della gravità (partito a y=%.1f, ora a y=%.1f)" % [start_y, flyer.global_position.y])

	var test_player := CharacterBody2D.new()
	test_player.velocity = Vector2(0.0, 200.0)

	if has_function(flyer, "_on_stomp_area_body_entered"):
		flyer.call("_on_stomp_area_body_entered", test_player)

	check("flyer_bounce", test_player.velocity.y < 0.0, "Saltare in testa al nemico volante deve far rimbalzare il giocatore (velocity.y = %.1f)" % test_player.velocity.y)
	check("flyer_freed", flyer.is_queued_for_deletion(), "Il nemico volante deve essere eliminato quando viene schiacciato dall'alto")

	if is_instance_valid(test_player):
		test_player.free()

func take_damage(_amount: int) -> void:
	if is_dead:

	is_dead = true
	velocity = Vector2.ZERO
	set_physics_process(false)
	await get_tree().create_timer(1.0).timeout

func respawn() -> void:
	global_position = spawn_position
	velocity = Vector2.ZERO
	is_dead = false
	set_physics_process(true)


func _physics_process(delta: float) -> void:
	if not is_on_floor():

	var direction := Input.get_axis("move_left", "move_right")
	if direction != 0.0:
		velocity.x = direction * speed
		if animated_sprite:

		velocity.x = move_toward(velocity.x, 0.0, speed)

extends CharacterBody2D

@export var speed: float = 60.0
@export var gravity: float = 980.0
@export var bounce_impulse: float = -320.0
@export var damage: int = 1

var direction: float = 1.0

@onready var sprite: Sprite2D = $Sprite2D
@onready var edge_detector: RayCast2D = $EdgeDetector
@onready var stomp_area: Area2D = $StompArea
@onready var hit_area: Area2D = $HitArea


func _ready() -> void:
	if stomp_area:
		stomp_area.body_entered.connect(_on_stomp_area_body_entered)
	if hit_area:
		hit_area.body_entered.connect(_on_hit_area_body_entered)


func _physics_process(delta: float) -> void:
	if not is_on_floor():
		velocity.y += gravity * delta

	if is_on_wall() or (is_on_floor() and edge_detector and not edge_detector.is_colliding()):
		_turn_around()

	velocity.x = direction * speed
	move_and_slide()


func _turn_around() -> void:
	direction *= -1.0
	if sprite:
		sprite.flip_h = direction < 0.0
	if edge_detector:
		edge_detector.position.x = absf(edge_detector.position.x) * direction


func _on_stomp_area_body_entered(body: Node2D) -> void:
	if is_queued_for_deletion():
		return
	if body is CharacterBody2D and body.velocity.y > 0.0:
		body.velocity.y = bounce_impulse
		queue_free()


func _on_hit_area_body_entered(body: Node2D) -> void:
	if is_queued_for_deletion():
		return
	if body.is_in_group("player") and body.has_method("take_damage"):
		if body is CharacterBody2D and body.velocity.y > 0.0 and body.global_position.y < global_position.y:
			return
		body.take_damage(damage)

extends CharacterBody2D

@export var speed: float = 80.0
@export var patrol_time: float = 2.0
@export var bounce_impulse: float = -320.0
@export var damage: int = 1

var direction: float = 1.0

@onready var sprite: Sprite2D = $Sprite2D
@onready var patrol_timer: Timer = $PatrolTimer
@onready var stomp_area: Area2D = $StompArea
@onready var hit_area: Area2D = $HitArea


func _ready() -> void:
	if patrol_timer:
		patrol_timer.wait_time = patrol_time
		patrol_timer.timeout.connect(_on_patrol_timer_timeout)
		patrol_timer.start()

	if stomp_area:
		stomp_area.body_entered.connect(_on_stomp_area_body_entered)
	if hit_area:
		hit_area.body_entered.connect(_on_hit_area_body_entered)


func _physics_process(_delta: float) -> void:
	if is_on_wall():
		_turn_around()
		if patrol_timer:
			patrol_timer.start()

	velocity.x = direction * speed
	velocity.y = 0.0
	move_and_slide()


func _turn_around() -> void:
	direction *= -1.0
	if sprite:
		sprite.flip_h = direction < 0.0


func _on_patrol_timer_timeout() -> void:
	_turn_around()


func _on_stomp_area_body_entered(body: Node2D) -> void:
	if is_queued_for_deletion():
		return
	if body is CharacterBody2D and body.velocity.y > 0.0:
		body.velocity.y = bounce_impulse
		queue_free()


func _on_hit_area_body_entered(body: Node2D) -> void:
	if is_queued_for_deletion():
		return
	if body.is_in_group("player") and body.has_method("take_damage"):
		if body is CharacterBody2D and body.velocity.y > 0.0 and body.global_position.y < global_position.y:
			return
		body.take_damage(damage)
